openapi: 3.0.0
info:
  title: Volopa OOP Expense API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: API for managing out-of-pocket expenses, user permissions, and CSV batch uploads
servers:
  - url: /api
security:
  - oauth2: []
paths:
  /v1/user-feature-permissions:
    get:
      summary: List user permissions
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Paginated list of permissions
    post:
      summary: Grant user permission
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                user_id: {type: integer}
                client_id: {type: integer}
                feature_id: {type: integer}
                manager_user_id: {type: integer}
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Permission granted successfully
  /v1/user-feature-permissions/{id}:
    get:
      summary: Get specific permission
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Permission details
    put:
      summary: Update permission
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Permission updated
    delete:
      summary: Revoke permission
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Permission revoked
  /v1/pocket-expenses:
    get:
      summary: List expenses
      parameters:
        - name: user_id
          in: query
          schema: {type: integer}
        - name: status
          in: query
          schema: {type: string, enum: [draft, submitted, approved, rejected]}
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Paginated expense list
    post:
      summary: Create expense
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                date: {type: string, format: date}
                merchant_name: {type: string}
                amount: {type: number}
                currency: {type: string}
                expense_type: {type: integer}
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Expense created with FX conversion
  /v1/pocket-expenses/{id}:
    get:
      summary: Get expense details
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Expense with metadata and FX info
    put:
      summary: Update expense
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Expense updated with recalculated FX
    delete:
      summary: Delete expense
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Expense soft deleted
  /v1/pocket-expense-sources:
    get:
      summary: List client expense sources
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Available sources for client
    post:
      summary: Create expense source
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Source created
  /uploads/pocket-expense/csv:
    post:
      summary: Upload CSV for batch processing
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          multipart/form-data:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                file: {type: string, format: binary}
                user_id: {type: integer}
                expense_user_id: {type: integer}
                client_id: {type: integer}
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Upload queued for processing
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  success: {type: boolean}
                  upload_id: {type: integer}
                  total_rows: {type: integer}
        '422':
          description: Validation failed
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  success: {type: boolean}
                  errors: {type: array}
  /uploads/pocket-expense/{uploadId}/status:
    get:
      summary: Get upload processing status
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Upload status and progress
components:
  securitySchemes:
    oauth2:
      type: oauth2
      flows: {}
Shared Knowledge: All models use multi-tenant client_id scoping. The PocketExpenseService handles FX conversion via PocketExpenseFXService for all expense operations. CSV validation uses PocketExpenseCSVValidator with preloaded reference data. Background processing via ProcessExpenseUpload job handles batch CSV imports. All API responses use API Resources for consistent formatting. Form Requests handle validation with policy authorization. Soft delete patterns use both flag-based (deleted/delete_time) and Laravel SoftDeletes (deleted_at) depending on table conventions.
Anything UNCLEAR: Several implementation details need clarification: 1) The notification channel for batch upload completion - whether to use in-app notifications, email, push notifications, or a combination, as the platform notification infrastructure existence is marked as UNKNOWN. 2) The exact integration pattern for FX conversion - whether this reuses an existing platform FX service or requires new integration, and the specific API endpoints for the wallet-ccy-value service and FX rate lookup. 3) The audit logging implementation approach for permission grants/revokes - whether to use a separate audit table, event sourcing, or Laravel activity log package. 4) The ClientFeatures model query pattern to check if client_id has feature_id=16 enabled, as the backing table structure is not defined. 5) Whether to use flag-based soft delete (deleted + delete_time) or Laravel SoftDeletes (deleted_at) for new tables, as both patterns coexist in the platform. These decisions should be made before implementation to ensure consistency with existing platform patterns.
